paraphrase: All the teachings of the Buddha — the vehicles, vows and practices — share a single intent; no teaching is to be rejected, each being a means toward awakening.
notes: Reference from memory; the text is not available locally. Topic anchor; low.

paraphrase: The vows of individual liberation, of the bodhisattva and of the mantra are one in essence, differing in their aspects according to the vehicle; they are kept together as a single discipline.
notes: Reference from memory; the text is not available locally. Topic anchor; the formulation 'sdom gsum ngo bo gcig' is recalled, not quoted.
